findings: All three in-scope findings (N4 Major, N5 Minor, N8 nit) fixed with red-first evidence, green confirmation, and full cap compliance (verified by an empty git diff against the round-2 base for every frozen file). abstract: Scoped fix round on car/tooling-50-32-car-r3, same worktree/branch, base db1d3da unchanged. Two commits, both touching only cap-exempt files (scripts/Reconcile-DispatchRecords.ps1 and its two test files) - verified by an empty git diff against every frozen surface named in the cap (session-start-record.sh, settings.json, copilot-instructions.md, ONBOARDING.md, the design doc, docs/setup.md). N4 (5ec45d9): the M5 epoch floor had silently made the #32 divergence pin's test 1 vacuous (its probe line was always pre-floor, always excluded, so producer-side subject drift stopped being caught - 14/14 green under round-1's injection C instead of the correct 8 passed/1 failed). Fixed by moving the fixture's timestamp post-floor; verified by hand-applying injection C to the real file, observing the pin fail by name (13/14), then reverting byte-identical (SHA-256 confirmed, git diff empty); a new permanent regression test was also landed using a disposable sibling-copy technique that never touches the real tracked file. N5 (5ec45d9): the reconciler's trailing success message overclaimed "every firing has a matching record" even when firings were excluded and none matched; fixed to a qualified message in that composition, unaffected in the all-matched or gap-reported compositions. N8 (7abfec8): child-process stdout was leaking into every suite run because ProcessStartInfo had no stream redirection; fixed with asynchronously-drained redirected streams, test-hygiene only, mechanism untouched. Final suite totals: scripts/tests 185/185 (182 round-2 base + 3 new), scripts/store-checks 159/159 unchanged, scripts/probes 24/24 unchanged.
